account.description: An account at a certificate authority. JEC registers it the first time it is used.
account.name: ACME account

error.ca: The certificate authority returned an error. The full log says why.
error.caa: The domain's CAA records do not allow this certificate authority. Add it to the CAA records.
error.directory: Cannot reach the certificate authority at {directory}. Check the network, or that the directory URL is right.
error.directory_required: Fill in the directory URL of the custom certificate authority.
error.eab_required: This certificate authority needs External Account Binding. Fill in the EAB Key ID and HMAC key of the account.
error.present: Could not add the record for {domain}. Check the DNS provider's credentials and permissions.
error.propagation: The records for {domains} never showed in DNS. Check that the DNS provider is the one that serves them.
error.rate_limited: The certificate authority refused for now: too many requests. JEC tries again when it allows.
error.register: The certificate authority did not accept the account. Check its settings, such as the EAB and the email.
error.rejected: The certificate authority does not issue certificates for these domains.
error.user_action: The certificate authority asks you to do something on its site first: {url}
error.validation: The certificate authority could not validate the domains. Check that the DNS provider is the one that serves them.

field.ca_help: For any other CA that speaks ACME, choose Custom and fill in its directory URL.
field.directory_help: The CA's ACME directory, given in its documentation; it usually ends in /directory.
field.eab_hmac_help: Comes with the Key ID; JEC uses it to register the account.
field.eab_kid_help: ZeroSSL, Google Trust Services and most paid CAs need it; their account page gives it.
field.email_help: The CA sends notices about the account here. Using the account means accepting the CA's terms of service.

log.cleanup_failed: Could not remove the record for {domain}; you can remove it at the DNS provider
log.issued: The certificate authority issued the certificate
log.not_visible: The record for {domain} does not show yet; checking again
log.wait: Waiting for the records to show in DNS, at most {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}

module.description: Gets certificates from any CA that speaks ACME, such as Let's Encrypt, ZeroSSL and Google Trust Services.
module.name: ACME

add.certificate_help: The certificate and its intermediates, in any order. The private key may go here too.
add.intro: Choose where the certificate comes from, then fill in what it needs.
add.key_help: Stored encrypted in the data directory. Leave it empty if the key is in the field above.

attention.expired_detail: {life}. Upload a new certificate to replace it.
attention.replace_detail: Uploaded certificates are not renewed automatically: {life}.
attention.title: Needs attention

delete.body: JEC deletes this certificate with every version and private key. Copies already deployed elsewhere stay where they are.
delete.title: Delete {domain}?

download.files: A ZIP file with cert.pem, chain.pem, fullchain.pem and privkey.pem, the format most web servers take.
download.intro: The download holds the private key. Enter your password to go on.
download.title: Download the certificate

error.bad_certificate: A certificate cannot be read. Paste it again in full, from -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE----- to -----END CERTIFICATE-----.
error.bad_domain: This is not a valid domain name. Write a wildcard as *.example.com.
error.bad_key: The private key cannot be read. Paste it again in full.
error.duplicate: This certificate has been added already.
error.encrypted_key: The private key is protected by a passphrase. Remove it first, for example with openssl pkey -in key.pem -out plain.pem, then paste the key again.
error.issue_failed: The issuance failed. The full log says why.
error.key_mismatch: The private key does not belong to this certificate. Check that both come from the same order or CSR.
error.no_certificate: No certificate found. Paste the certificate in PEM format, starting with -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----.
error.no_key: No private key found. Paste the private key in PEM format.
error.no_source: This certificate has no source to issue it. Upload new versions instead.
error.not_newer: This certificate expires before the one in use. Upload a newer certificate.
error.other_domains: This certificate is not for {domain}. Upload one that covers {domain}, or add it as a new certificate.
error.provider_missing: A provider this certificate uses was deleted.
error.provider_unavailable: A provider this certificate uses is not available; its module may be off. Retries go on once the module is back.
error.several_keys: More than one private key was pasted. Keep only the key of this certificate.
error.unsupported_key: This type of private key is not supported. Use an RSA, ECDSA or Ed25519 key.
error.wrong_provider: This provider cannot be used here. Choose another one.

list.empty: No certificates yet. Add the first one, and JEC warns you before it expires.

log.done: Done in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}
log.gave_up: No more automatic retries. Once the cause is fixed, issue the certificate again.
log.interrupted: JEC stopped during the issuance; starting over
log.key: New private key: {kind, select, rsa {RSA {size}} ecdsa {ECDSA {size}} other {{kind}}}
log.retry: Trying again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}
log.stored: Certificate saved, valid for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
